entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while I connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, agent ID 301. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac. I need to make a return for an order I received a few days ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Sure, the name is Alex Chen, and the order number is VF-8675309.
Thank you, Alex. I see your order for the Pro-Vent Performance Jersey, delivered on January 6th. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the jersey?
Of course. It's simply the wrong size. I ordered a medium, but it's much too tight across the shoulders. I'd like to start an exchange for a large if possible.

Okay, so it's a fit preference, not a defect with the item. Thank you for clarifying. Since you received it just four days ago, you are well within our 90-day return window for apparel. I can absolutely set up that exchange for you.

That's good to hear. Now, since I have to go through the process of shipping this back and waiting for the new one, is there any chance you could apply a small discount to the exchange? Or maybe provide a credit for the inconvenience?

I understand the process takes a bit of time, Alex. While our policy doesn't allow for credits or discounts on a standard size exchange, I can confirm the return shipping is completely free. I'm generating a pre-paid return label that I'll email to you right after our call.
I appreciate the free return shipping. I just feel like my time is worth something. Are you sure you can't offer even a 10% off code for a future purchase? I buy a lot of gear from VeloFit.

I do see you're a loyal customer, and we appreciate that. Unfortunately, my system is strict and doesn't have an option to issue goodwill credits for sizing issues. The best I can do is ensure this exchange is as smooth and cost-free as possible for you. We'll ship the new size out the same day we receive your return.
Alright, Isaac. A pre-paid label and a quick turnaround on the new jersey is a fair solution. I can accept that. Please go ahead and send the email.
Excellent. I've just processed the exchange for a size large and the email with the return label is on its way to your inbox. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you for your help.
You're very welcome, Alex. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
